source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council issue Development Variance Permit No. DVP16-0015 for the City of Langford to
        Harry Skagberg on behalf of Pacific Coast Land Co. Inc. to vary the parking and setback
        requirements for a 6 unit stacked townhouse development located at 2691 Peatt Rd subject to
        the following terms and conditions:

        1. Appendix
            The site shall be developed in accordance with the site plan attached (Appendix A).

        2. Variances
            The following regulations of Zoning Bylaw No. 300 are varied under Section 498 of the Local
            Government Act:
            a) That Section 4.01.01 of the City of Langford Zoning Bylaw 300 be varied to reduce the
               number of required parking stalls from 2 stalls per dwelling unit to 1 stall per dwelling
               unit for Attached Housing and Townhouses;
            b) That Section 6.36A.06(2) be varied to reduce the interior side lot line setback from the
               required 3 m to 1.5 m; and
            c) That Section 6.36A.06(1) be varied to reduce the front lot line setback from the required
               7.5mto0m.

         3. Conditions
             The following requirements are imposed under Section 498 of the Local Government Act:
             a) The applicant providing $5,000 towards the General Amenity Reserve Fund, prior to the
                issuance of a Development Permit;
             b) That the applicant provide a planting plan, prior to issuance of a building permit, to the
                satisfaction of the Director of Planning and the Parks Manager, to plant boulevard trees

                                                                        Regular Council Minutes — November 21s`, 2016
                                                                                                          Page 3 of 9


                along the frontage of Peatt Road, and that irrigations are provided to the boulevard trees
                from 2691 Peatt Road
